summary: Comprehensive test of SIH 2026 procurement portal refactor: role/mandi data isolation, officer approval, FCFS ordering, booking-processing authorization, job-decision authorization, grievance mandi requirement, and frontend refactor pages. 24/25 backend tests pass. Key bug found: admin CAN call POST /api/admin/bookings/{bid}/start (returns 200) — the requirement says admin should get 403. /complete and /pay correctly return 403 for admin but /start is missing the admin-block. Also found a latent code bug: server.py line 969 has a stray '@api.get("/admin/mandis")' decorator that ends up applied to admin_analytics(), registering admin_analytics twice under two paths.

critical.issue: Admin is NOT blocked from starting a booking. Returns 200 for admin. Requirement: only Mandi Owner can start/complete/pay. Add `if user['role'] == 'admin': raise HTTPException(403, 'Only Mandi Owner can start processing')` inside start_processing() (server.py ~line 704-712), mirroring the check that exists in complete_procurement() and pay().

minor.issue: Stray decorator `@api.get("/admin/mandis")` above the analytics function has no function body attached to it — decorators attach to the next `def`, so admin_analytics() gets registered twice: at /admin/analytics AND at /admin/mandis. FastAPI resolves in registration order so the earlier /admin/mandis (line 754) still wins, but this is a latent bug. Delete line 969.

verified_ok: Officer registration POST /api/auth/officer-register creates pending user (blocked from login → 403 'Officer account is pending')
GET /api/admin/bookings as admin: 75 bookings, sorted by created_at ASC (FCFS)
GET /api/admin/bookings as officer: 8 bookings, ALL mandi_id=mandi-pb-khn-01 (Khanna), FCFS order
GET /api/admin/grievances: admin sees all, Khanna officer sees only Khanna grievances
GET /api/admin/machinery and /api/admin/jobs are correctly scoped per officer's mandi
POST /api/grievances requires mandi_id, subject, description (422 on missing mandi_id)
Cross-officer isolation: a fresh officer with a different mandi gets 404 when trying /start on a Khanna booking, and empty [] when listing bookings
Frontend /officer-register step 2 renders 'e-NAM / APMC Commission ID' input + 'Find your Commission ID on e-NAM' link (href=https://www.enam.gov.in/web/)
Frontend /grievances form: only Mandi (data-testid=grievance-mandi) + Subject + Description + optional Booking; NO hardcoded category chips
Frontend /admin/officers page code renders commission_id and Verify-on-e-NAM link with data-testid=enam-verify-{id} (server returns commission_id in officer-applications)
Frontend /admin/bookings has setInterval(load, 5000) with cleanup (AdminBookings.jsx line 25) — verified via 1 request captured in 7s window
action_items: Add admin 403 block inside start_processing() in server.py so /api/admin/bookings/{bid}/start returns 403 when user['role'] == 'admin' (mirror complete/pay).
Delete stray `@api.get("/admin/mandis")` decorator on server.py line 969 (causes double-registration of admin_analytics).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py start_processing() missing admin-role block that /complete and /pay both have. Inconsistent authorization logic.
server.py line 969: dangling route decorator attaches to next function definition. Must be deleted.
decide_application() uses `decision: str` as query parameter (not body). Consider making it a JSON body for consistency, though this is stylistic.
grievance category has default 'other' but the frontend never surfaces it — safe for backward compat but consider removing the field from the model/UI entirely.
server.py is 1037 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into modules (auth.py, bookings.py, grievances.py, jobs.py).
load_dotenv is only called for backend/.env; if any code sets env vars elsewhere, may need explicit override=False handling (currently fine).
test_credentials: Admin 9999900001/Admin@123, Officer 9999900002/Officer@123 (owns Khanna Grain Market mandi-pb-khn-01), Farmer 9876543210/Farmer@123
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_-prefixed officers via /auth/officer-register and creates fresh bookings when needed. No cleanup performed — safe because prefix isolates them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses pytest-xdist -n 2 loadscope from pytest.ini). Run with: `cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://agri-proc-track-1.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`. If Khanna has no 'booked' bookings, the fixture will create one via farmer. After fix for admin-start-block, only 1 test needs re-run: TestBookingProcessing::test_admin_cannot_start.
rca of the issue: server.py has admin-blocks in complete_procurement (line 720-722) and pay (line 740-741) that raise HTTPException(403, 'Only Mandi Owner...') when user['role'] == 'admin'. The same block was NOT added in start_processing() at line 704. Fix: insert `if user['role'] == 'admin': raise HTTPException(403, 'Only Mandi Owner can start processing')` before the update statement in start_processing().
